title: Unisex New Year's Eve – Midnight Is a Suggestion Crewneck Sweatshirt

seo.title: Midnight Is a Suggestion – New Years Sweatshirt
seo.description: New years sweatshirt: a couple asleep in party hats under a clock stuck at ten past ten, MIDNIGHT IS A SUGGESTION. Unisex crewneck, S–3XL.

descriptionHtml:
The Story

Midnight is a suggestion: a New Year's sweatshirt for whoever plans to be asleep before the ball drops.

The art is a couple asleep shoulder to shoulder on a striped sofa in paper party hats, a noisemaker still in his mouth and bare feet tucked up, under a wall clock stuck at ten past ten with confetti drifting down. MIDNIGHT IS A runs across the top in heavy capitals and SUGGESTION across the bottom in red, navy and red on Sand, cream and coral on Navy.

Wear it to the early night in, the quiet New Year's Eve at home or the party you leave at 10:30. It is a unisex crewneck, so size down for a closer fit. Printed the day you order it.

Details & Fit

  • Classic unisex crewneck sweatshirt fit
  • 50% cotton, 50% polyester fleece
  • Fabric weight: 8 oz/yd²
  • Ribbed crew neck, cuffs and waistband; no hood, no pockets
  • Sizes S–3XL
  • 2 colors: Sand, Navy

Questions

How does the Midnight Is a Suggestion crewneck fit?
This classic unisex Gildan 18000 crewneck from Graphic Tees Co. comes in sizes S through 3XL and runs a little roomy. Order your usual size for a relaxed fit, or size down for a closer one. If the size is off, we offer one free size exchange within 30 days of delivery.

How warm is it and what is it made of?
The Midnight Is a Suggestion crewneck from Graphic Tees Co. is 50% cotton and 50% polyester fleece at 8 oz per square yard, with a ribbed collar, cuffs and waistband and no hood. It is a mid-weight, cozy layer for a night on the couch. Machine wash cold inside out and tumble dry low.

What colors does it come in and how is it printed?
It comes in Sand and Navy, both in sizes S through 3XL. On Sand the headline is navy and SUGGESTION red; on Navy the headline turns cream and SUGGESTION coral, with a cream outline around the sleeping couple so the whole scene stays clear. Graphic Tees Co. prints each one to order.

Is this a good gift for someone who skips the party?
Yes. The Midnight Is a Suggestion crewneck from Graphic Tees Co. suits the friend who is on the couch by 10:30, a partner who treats the countdown as optional, or a coworker with a dry sense of humor. Orders over $45 ship free, and the free size exchange covers a wrong guess.

When should I order for New Year's Eve?
Order by about December 20 so the Midnight Is a Suggestion crewneck from Graphic Tees Co. arrives before New Year's Eve. Each sweatshirt is printed to order, which takes a few business days, then ships within the US. Orders of $45 or more ship free, and a misprint or damaged item is reprinted or refunded within 30 days.
